plans.note: Para 21.3 (p0242) is the mutual liability exclusion ('Under no circumstances shall any Party be liable...'); check consequential-loss scope, any cap and carve-outs. p0126 (4.9) excludes PG-member liability; p0241 (21.2) is the mutual indemnity interacting with the cap. Assess mutuality in a multilateral consortium rather than a one-sided vendor cap.

Para 21.2 (p0241) is a reciprocal Party-to-Party indemnity; Paragraph 32 (p0275 onward, incl. p0280) handles settlement/sharing of third-party claims. Read the full Paragraph 32 run in sec-p0115 for scope (third-party IP claims may be absent) and confirm our exposure is proportionate to Investment Share.

No non-compete or field-of-use restraint surfaced; 'compete' hits are 'competent tribunal/jurisdiction'. p0206/p0208 confirm capacity may be sold or IRU'd 'without any restrictions' — beneficial to us, do not flag. Confirm no restraint in the Paragraph 12/15 capacity provisions.

Only 'exclusive' usage is the sole-and-exclusive-remedy language in dispute resolution (p0262), which belongs to GOVLAW. Capacity provisions (p0206, p0208) expressly permit dealing with other carriers, so no purchasing exclusivity burdens us.
No most-favoured-nation or more-favourable-terms language anywhere in the document; treat as inapplicable to this construction and maintenance agreement.
No solicitation, hiring or personnel-restriction language found; likely genuinely absent in a consortium agreement.

Paragraph 18 is the exit regime: 18.1 (p0228) permits a Party to terminate its participation at the end of or after the 25-year Initial Period on notice; 18.2 (p0229) in-period termination only by unanimous agreement; 18.3 (p0230) decommissioning; 18.4-18.7 (p0231, p0232, p0235) consequences. Assess the Initial Period lock-in, notice length, continuing cost liability and whether exit is penalty-free (cross-check p0256).

No auto-renewal with price uplift; instead a 25-year Initial Period continuing thereafter until terminated (p0228), with decommissioning (p0230) and exit mechanics (p0231). Analyse as evergreen continuation: notice window and whether post-Initial-Period exit is unilateral and free of renewal pricing risk.

Paragraph 27.1 (p0262) escalates disputes to the Management Committee, which may determine arbitration, and is the 'sole and exclusive remedy'; no governing law or court venue surfaced. Likely deviation (no accepted governing law; committee-determined arbitration displacing courts). p0239 (Paragraph 20 privilege in arbitration) and p0260 (compliance with applicable laws) are context; confirm no choice-of-law sentence elsewhere.

Paragraph 22.1 (p0246) restricts assignment subject to Paragraph 12 carve-outs; Paragraph 30 (p0269) binds successors and permitted assigns. Check affiliate/successor assignment without consent and whether change of control triggers any Party's exit; p0189/p0206/p0208 are the capacity transfer and IRU freedoms.

Ownership here is asset/capacity ownership, not IP or customer data: 4.1 (p0107) and 4.3 (p0119) allocate Segment ownership per Schedule B; 12.2 (p0187) gives Allocated Capacity on an ownership basis; p0210/p0214 govern revised ownership and transfers; p0054 defines IRU as conveying no ownership. No IP-assignment or data clause surfaced — confirm, and verify our ownership interest cannot be diluted without consent.

The licence analogue is the IRU regime: p0054 (IRU for the life of APCN 2, no ownership/voting), p0206/p0208 (right to sell IRU or use capacity for other Carriers without restriction), p0189 (assignment of capacity). Confirm irrevocability for system life and extension to affiliates/other carriers. The 'licence' hits at p0236-p0238 are governmental permits under Paragraph 19, not a grant.

Paragraph 9 (p0160 onward) is the books and inspection regime; 9.8 (p0167) gives any Party, including us, review/audit rights; 10.8 (p0177) gives inspection rights at the inspecting Party's own expense; p0123 covers construction inspection access. Largely reciprocal and in our favour — check notice, frequency and cost before flagging.

Paragraph 23 Default (p0255, p0256) is the main exposure: on payment default the Management Committee may reclaim assigned capacity with no payment or credit to the defaulting Party — assess as forfeiture/penalty against us. Also extended payment charges/interest at p0153, p0154, p0155 and disputed-bill payment at p0157. Coordinate with T4C to avoid double-flagging the same exit cost.

Para 4.9 (p0126) disclaims all PG representations and warranties (list follows) and p0127 states nothing shall be construed as a warranty or guarantee. Likely deviation on the no-warranty position; read the full 4.9 list and check for supplier-contract warranty flow-down in Paragraphs 4 and 10.

No insurance covenant; insurance appears only as a cost category (p0133, including an allowance in lieu where a Party self-insures) and optional joint insurance charged to Capital Costs (p0139). Treat as no maintain-insurance obligation and note the self-insurance election as residual risk.

The commitment is the Investment Share / Minimum Investment Unit structure: p0055 (MIU definition), p0187 (capacity in return for financial investment per Schedules B/C). Read Paragraphs 5 and 7 (cost definition, allocation and billing) within sec-p0115 for mandatory contributions and true-ups, and pair with the Paragraph 18 exit before concluding take-or-pay-without-exit.

End-of-life mechanics sit in Paragraph 18 realization of assets (p0230 decommissioning, p0231 arrangements with remaining Parties, p0232 Schedule amendment, p0235 survival) plus p0280 (obligations surviving termination) and p0180/p0185 (early termination of a connected system; sharing of net proceeds). No data-return or transition-assistance obligation as such — confirm, and check continuity of our capacity if another Party exits.
